final: WITH station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.station_avg) AS mean_station_average, AVG(s.station_avg - b.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avgs AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.station_avg > b.overall_avg
